crack_signal_threshold: spread widening >300bp on IREN/TeraWulf/CoreWeave/Applied Digital notes
data_source: TRACE / FINRA bond prints; the $184.8B direct-tier CUSIPs
negative_control: hyperscaler IG spreads (Oracle/Alphabet) moving is macro, not AI-crack -- watch the direct tier specifically

crack_signal_threshold: a direct-tier issuer pulls or reprices a refi >100bp; maturity-wall row not rolled
ties_to_finding: maturity_rate_coverage_expansion (AI pure-plays carry the rate/maturity gap)
negative_control: a routine opportunistic raise is not a failure -- require evidence of inability to roll

crack_signal_threshold: Amazon/Google/Microsoft Energy cancels or defers PPA capacity; tracker 'cancelled' MW rises
data_source: FERC EQR (dataset 17); DC tracker cancelled_capacity_mw (currently 18,514 MW)
negative_control: a single project slip is noise; watch aggregate cancelled MW trend + named hyperscaler pullback

indicator: GPU resale price / rental rate decline
crack_signal_threshold: secondary H100/H200 price or Lambda/RunPod rental rate falls >20% QoQ
data_source: broker feeds + Lambda/RunPod pricing scrapes (compute lane stubs)
negative_control: new-gen launch transitions cause orderly price steps; watch utilization-adjusted decline

crack_signal_threshold: neocloud utilization <70% or contracted-revenue backlog flattens
negative_control: ramp-phase low utilization is expected; compare to disclosed contracted backlog

crack_signal_threshold: a top DC project's ISO queue position slips >1yr or IA not executed by guidance
data_source: ISO queues (PJM/ERCOT/MISO ERAS/NYISO); physical-lane acquisition cards
ties_to_finding: physical_grid_refresh (0 MW firm; 341,962 MW announced un-de-risked)
negative_control: queue churn is normal; watch the named top-15 projects' firm-status transitions

crack_signal_threshold: a PUC denies DC-driven generation cost recovery, or a utility writes down DC-load capex
ties_to_finding: utility_ratepayer_downside (rate-base recovery is the loss channel)
negative_control: routine rate cases approve recovery; watch DENIALS or stranded-cost language

crack_signal_threshold: a direct-tier issuer reports a covenant waiver, going-concern, or DSCR <1.0
negative_control: amend-and-extend is common; require an actual waiver/going-concern, not a renegotiation

crack_signal_threshold: a direct-tier name does back-to-back ATM/convert raises to fund opex (not capex)
negative_control: growth capex raises are bullish; flag only raises funding losses/refis
